announcement.goal.saint: Set yourself as bait and burden your Hellfire killer with Karma.
announcement.goals.saint: Help the passengers. Complete tasks for 50 coins; invoking Hellfire costs 175 coins. You have limited sprint stamina and cannot pick up guns. Civilian-side players cannot kill you; Voodoo may bind you, but its final chained death is canceled. After a 60-second initial cooldown, invoke Hellfire for 15 seconds. If a non-civilian player other than Grand Witch kills you during it, that killer is burdened with Karma until the round ends unless they later become Grand Witch, which clears the mark permanently. After each successful player kill, timed-bomb transfer, or poison-needle hit, every cooldown-capable item type in their inventory, hotbar, and offhand enters cooldown for 5 seconds, or 20 seconds if their current role is Bomber. Longer existing cooldowns are preserved. Item cooldowns already applied before becoming Grand Witch expire normally. Surviving Hellfire starts a 60-second cooldown.

skill.sparkwitch.ceremonial_sword.descri: Unlocked after 2 completed tasks. Spend 150 mana to turn one knife into a Ceremonial Sword for 15 seconds and gain Speed II.
skill.sparkwitch.mighty_force.name: Mighty Force
skill.sparkwitch.mighty_force.descriptio: Spend 80 mana. For 10 seconds, an empty-hand left click knocks a player back and makes one lethal attack.
skill.sparkwitch.swift_step.name: Swift Step
skill.sparkwitch.swift_step.description: Spend 30 mana to gain Speed III for 5 seconds.
skill.sparkwitch.murder_sense.name: Murder Sense
skill.sparkwitch.murder_sense.descriptio: Spend 60 mana to highlight players within 20 blocks who are holding dangerous items in red for 15 seconds.
skill.sparkwitch.healing.name: Healing
skill.sparkwitch.healing.description: Spend 40 mana to restore 3 sanity per second to nearby innocent players for 20 seconds.
skill.sparkwitch.clairvoyance.name: Clairvoyance
skill.sparkwitch.clairvoyance.descriptio: Spend 80 mana to highlight yourself in pale blue for 30 seconds and other living players in white for 10 seconds.
skill.sparkwitch.pig_chase.name: Pig Chase
skill.sparkwitch.pig_chase.description: Spend 150 coins to enter 17 seconds of quiet Psycho chase with Speed V, wathe door blasts, and living-player highlights.
skill.sparkwitch.death_ray.name: Death Ray
skill.sparkwitch.death_ray.description: Spend 100 mana. For 10 seconds, left-click to fire 3 red rays within 12 blocks. Walls block the ray.
skill.sparkwitch.ninja_parry.name: Parry
skill.sparkwitch.ninja_parry.description: After a 60-second initial cooldown, guard for 2.5 seconds and block one lethal player attack. Blocking or expiry starts a 180-second cooldown.
skill.sparkwitch.death_omen.name: Death Omen
skill.sparkwitch.death_omen.description: After a 60-second initial cooldown, reveal newly created bodies through walls within 128 blocks for 20 seconds. A full omen starts a 90-second cooldown.
skill.sparkwitch.perception.name: Perception
skill.sparkwitch.perception.description: Sense nearby players for 15 seconds. Each ten seconds in range permanently reveals that player's role for this round.
skill.sparkwitch.kidnapper_drag_body.des: Aim at a body within 2 blocks to drag it. Use the skill again to release it. Movement speed is reduced to 80% while dragging.
skill.sparkwitch.sabotage.name: Sabotage
skill.sparkwitch.sabotage.description: After a 60-second initial cooldown, black out all eligible train lights within 20 blocks for 20 seconds. Each use starts a 120-second cooldown.
skill.sparkwitch.curser.name: Curse
skill.sparkwitch.curser.description: After a 60-second initial cooldown, curse all living players within 8 blocks for 10 seconds. Cursed players cannot use instinct and see every other player with Wathe's low-sanity psycho skin. Each successful cast starts a 90-second cooldown.
skill.sparkwitch.guardian.name: Guardian
skill.sparkwitch.guardian.description: After a 60-second initial cooldown, aim at a living player within 3 blocks and press the shared ability key to secretly apply one Guardian Shield for 10 seconds. A successful cast starts a 90-second cooldown.

item.sparkwitch.hunter_trap.tooltip.line: - Place a trap on the targeted surface; it arms after 0.5 seconds.
- Victims are rooted for 3 seconds and gain one Fracture stack.
- Fracture blocks sprint and stamina recovery, slows 20% per stack, and each stack lasts 60 seconds.
- Native killers may coat a placed trap with a Poison Vial; poison lasts 40 seconds.
- Keep up to 2 traps. Sneak-use your own trap to reclaim it.
item.sparkwitch.double_barrel_shotgun.to: - Right-click the shotgun with a shell in your inventory, or use shells from the other hand.
- Straight shot with an effective range of 8 blocks.
- Load the second shell within 10 seconds of the first, or fire before reloading again.
- Firing cools down for 0.2 seconds with a shell left, or 30 seconds when empty.
